CUN_TextFileLineLoader strips every line and SKIPS blank lines, so a blank line in a .lines file silently shifts every later beat's prompt by one. JWStringUnescape turns an invalid escape (backslash-s) into a DeprecationWarning and renders changed text. Both are preflight refusals (blank_line, roundtrip).
